component.name: Easy Screen Recorder
component.summary: Graba la pantalla en dos clics
Record your screen in two clicks

description.p: Grabador de pantalla ligero para KDE Plasma sobre Wayland. La captura la hace gpu-screen-recorder, 100 % en GPU; Easy Screen Recorder pone la capa que falta: una interfaz de dos clics, modo de solo audio y defaults sensatos.

Lightweight screen recorder for KDE Plasma on Wayland. Capture is done by gpu-screen-recorder, fully on the GPU; Easy Screen Recorder adds the missing layer: a two-click interface, audio-only mode and sane defaults.
